agent_findings.detail: Title page and Contents — front matter is legitimately sparse; probe false positive, waived on visual judgment.

Source Crosswalk table spills a single dangling row (ch8) onto page 5, leaving ~85% of the page empty. Known first-pass cosmetic blemish, still present. Fix: keep the 8-row table together or tighten row spacing in book-print.css.
Chapter-final pages (end of ch2 / ch4) — short closing pages before a fresh chapter opener are normal book pagination; mild, waived.
Chapter 7 ends with only 2 lines on an otherwise empty page (~90% blank) — a widow chapter-final page. Cosmetic; better widow control (pull-back or spread adjustment) would absorb it.

slide-1008 (ch1, anchor_para 5, wrap-left) floats forward past the end of its short chapter onto Chapter 2's opening page, sitting above-left of the CHAPTER TWO heading and displacing the heading + drop cap off center. Mechanism: book-print.css clears floats before standalone figures but the chapter-open block has no clear:both. Fixture contribution: auto-layout anchored a 40% wrap at para 5 of a very short chapter.

Two 40%-width wrap figures anchored at the same paragraph render side-by-side (p8: slide-1005 left + slide-1006 right; p25: slide-1009 + slide-1012 both align:right — CSS legally stacks the second right-float to the left of the first). The text between/beside them collapses to a one-word-per-line sliver column. Renderer obeyed align/flow/width; the collision is the auto-layout's same-anchor pairing. Re-curate in the Book Composer: separate anchors or make one standalone.
slide-1014 (The Unbroken Chain of Witnesses) is a dense raster diagram placed as a 40% wrap; internal node labels are below comfortable print readability. Better curated as flow:standalone at 60%+.
